extraCopy: Take leeks, for instance. Jolant gives you an early crop for late summer, while hardy Musselburgh is a good choice if you want to lift a few for soup in January. The planting drawings show what to do when the seedlings are pencil-thick.

blurb: Each crop has a pair of illustrated pages. You can choose a variety, check when to sow and see how far apart to plant, all with the seed packet still in your hand.
closing: If the slugs get to your lettuces first, there’s practical advice on protecting the next row. When the last potatoes are lifted, the chapters on compost and crop rotation will help you plan what goes in their place.
